note: Official corporate actions (merger / delisting). Used by (1) the daily scan: a ticker whose lastTradingDate is before the market's latest session is excluded before scoring; (2) the paper ledger: a held position is converted per paperConversion on the first scan whose market close date ≥ effectiveSession (cash + whole acquirer shares + cash in lieu of the fraction at the acquirer's official close on the effective date). Prices come from public sources listed per action; nothing is estimated.

paperConversion.cashInLieuBasis: fractional FOXA entitlement × FOXA official close on the effective date (the 8-K says cash in lieu is paid per the Merger Agreement; the agreement's exact averaging formula is not applied here)
paperConversion.fractionalPolicy: whole FOXA shares only; the fraction is paid in cash
